text:
maria: Quick ask from ACME PM 1: small co-marketing bundle: 45m joint demo webinar, a short benchmark post, and ACME Exchange connector listing. Need compact ops plan and owners.

aj: I can run webinar ops + MC. Suggested date Tue Apr 7 10am PT. Any conflicts?

maria: Customer prefers Apr 7. aj please own invites + runbook + rehearsal slots.

kevin: Ill own the Exchange listing copy and connector screenshots. Need final product screenshots and a 2-line value prop by Friday EOD.

ellie: Ill draft the benchmark narrative. Need demo dataset and perf numbers by Monday to include a stat.

priya: Ill do inbound routing: HubSpot -> SFDC. Question: route partner leads to Partner SDR queue or Product demo queue initially?

maria: Start with Partner SDR queue, then escalate to Product demo if qualified. Priya set utm_source=acme_partner, lead_source=ACME_webinar.

priya: Suggested minimal form hidden fields + webhook payload for ingestion:
```
// hidden fields
utm_source: "acme_partner"
lead_source: "ACME_webinar"
partner_account: "acme-inc"
route_to_queue: "partner-sdr"
// webhook payload posted to /hooks/marketing/lead-ingest
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{firstname}}",
  "tags": ["acme","exchange","webinar"]
}
```

aj: Good. For the landing page can we reuse the ACME demo clip + a 1-min highlight? Ill wireframe and post by Tuesday.

kevin: Ill export screenshots at 1200px and 800px today. Draft value prop: "Redwood + ACME: low-latency inference for cloud data in ACME Exchange." Thoughts?

ellie: If infra can give a stat, make it explicit: e.g., "~30% lower p95 latency on standard queries." Otherwise keep generic.

samir: Compliance: add a short data-responsibility note on LP and listing: "No customer data retained; demo infra isolated." Ill draft copy.

maria: ops-bot, can you create a shared doc and calendar invite?

ops-bot: Created doc https://redwood.app/marketing/acme/co-marketing-playbook and event "ACME Exchange demo 1 prep" Apr 7 10:00 PT.

aj: Ill post run-of-show and rehearsal times (Wed Apr 1, Thu Apr 2). Post-webinar followup email + CTA to listing is my action.

priya: Will deliver UTM'd URLs and HubSpot form embed by Tue morning. Also setting Slack alert flow: #partner-sdrs ping with lead summary on new regs.

kevin: Do we have ACME logo kit? If not, ping their PM. If missing by Fri, use mono logo and get samir approval.

ellie: Timeline check:
- Today: kevin screenshots
- Fri EOD: value prop + logo confirmed
- Mon: infra numbers to ellie
- Tue: landing wireframe + form
- Wed/Thu: rehearsals
- Apr 7: webinar
- Apr 9: publish blog + soft-listing

maria: Please confirm ownership in the shared doc so ACME PM sees it.

kevin: Confirmed  listing + screenshots + value prop.

ellie: Confirmed  bench draft + numbers on Mon.

aj: Confirmed  webinar ops, runbook, rehearsals, post-email.

priya: Confirmed  lead routing, UTMs, SDR alerts.

samir: Confirmed  compliance blurb + co-brand fallback approval.

maria: Great. Keep this thread for quick clarifications; ping me for any blockers. :raised_hands:
